content: Final-filing rule: from ONE list_docs call, take the filings for the asked 사업연도 and period. The final confirmed source is the latest-submitted one ([기재정정] or [정정] beats the original; 잠정/preliminary disclosures never count). If a correction filing shows 정정 전/정정 후, use 정정 후. Once you have read a value from the latest-dated filing, do not re-run list_docs or search for further corrections; compute the unit conversion and answer.
